student_eligibility: Valid full-time student status is required.
student_proof: A student ID or official enrollment certificate is required.
grounding_rules: The model may use only information explicitly provided in this fact card.
Missing information must be identified as unavailable and must not be invented.
The sender's statement that she is a PhD student or will present a paper is a user claim, not verified eligibility.
The early-bird fee applies only if the relevant conditions and deadline are satisfied.
The email does not supply a current date or payment date, so a payment described as next week cannot be evaluated against May 1, 2027.
Accommodation recommendations, hotel rates, breakfast arrangements, invoice policy and tax-ID handling must not be invented.
Invoice and payment-policy questions require human review.
